overview:
The claim of this chapter, "the big statement" of these classes, is that the *hishtalshelus* is not a machine. When you contemplate the lights and vessels of *Atzilus* in detail, the main point is *ihu v'chayohi chad*, *ihu v'garmohi chad*: G-d is one with the vessels just as with the lights, because He chose both. The root of the vessels, the *reshimu* and the simple matter that comes before the form, is even before the root of the lights.

To show it, the Mitteler Rebbe distinguishes two kinds of limit. A *gvul b'koach*, like the hand's power of movement, is spiritual, essential and a freedom; a *gvul b'poel*, the throw once thrown, is physical and only one thing. The vessels of *Atzilus* are only a limit in potential, and the One who wills is the one who limits the will, like a person refusing a sardine sandwich. So the money that comes through *chesed* is His choice too, and the *kavanos* in prayer point to Him. In their root the roles reverse: what is limited as revealed spreads in the source, like the Rebbe in his room.

sections.title: When you contemplate lights and vessels in detail: He is one with the vessels as with the lights
sections.summary: The main point of contemplating the lights and vessels of *Atzilus* in detail is that G-d is one with the vessels just as He is one with the lights. The root of the vessels is even before the root of the lights: something has to make the light stop and take a form, and that is the simple matter that comes before the form.

blocks.text: **However, when you're going to do hisbonenus** (contemplation) **in the oros and kelim** (the lights and vessels) **of Atzilus** (the world of Emanation) **in a more particular way**, the main thing is not what was explained so far, how the lights are limited in the vessels and change *mahus* (nature); that is only the general picture. blocks.text: In a particular *hisbonenus*, the main thing is that the vessels' limitation comes straight from G-d's *bechira chofshis* (free choice), so it reveals His *etzem* (essence) and His *kol yachol*-ness (His being all-powerful) as much as the light does.

blocks.text: **Even though the lights are b'li ma** (without a what) **and the vessels are already like a tangible, concrete thing that is limited**, the lights are not the better revelation. From the side of the *Atzmus haMaatzil* (the Essence of the Emanator), the root of the vessels came first: the lights come from the *Kav* (the ray of light), the vessels from the *reshimu* (the impression left after the *tzimtzum*), which is before the *Kav*. His limited revelation is in a way higher than His being only infinite.

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: from the fact that from the thickening of the light comes the vessel,

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: This is apparent **from the fact that from the thickening of the light comes the vessel**: **there has to be something before that.** What makes light, which keeps going straight, stop and take a form? What made G-d's infinite light go into *chesed* (kindness), *chachma* (wisdom), any vessel? Something higher: *mamash* (actually) G-d choosing a particular form, stronger than the light because it forces it, "the boss of the light."

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: We see it in the body, a separate existence from the soul; and the power of sight is in a way made of the limited things it sees: that is what being a power of sight means.

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: or the *chomer hiyuli*,

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: which goes before the form.

blocks.text: **And this source for the vessel that comes before the light is called the simple chomer** (matter), **or the chomer hiyuli** (the raw, formless matter), **which goes before the form**, which is given to it. The soul forms the body, the thickening of the light, but the matter is there first. The world already has its limits, and your *ratzon* (will) meeting them comes out a certain way: the form is not wholly from the light.

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: A cup to drink water
blocks.text: You want a cup; really you want to drink water. That *ratzon* takes a cup's form because water must be held in something waterproof, shaped to keep it in: your *ratzon* made tangible, the thickening of the light. But it presupposes the properties of water and of the ceramic or plastic; you build the form from definitions that already exist.

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: The seed and the power of growth
blocks.text: So the light needs limits to work with, or it would never come out one way rather than another. The power of growth needs a seed, whose limits tell it how to grow into a certain tree. What is *metzamtzem* (limits) it comes from a higher source, a separate thing in a way.

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: So the soul gives the body form and life, but the body already has its DNA, a form of its own. So, as explained in certain places, the vessel comes not just from the light thickening but from its striking the *chomer hapashut*.

audio.lecture: 57 - Chap- 29-1 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: Two reference points
blocks.text: The *hiyuli* of the *reshimu* and the *hiyuli* of the *Kav* strike each other and are synthesized into a certain vessel. Two reference points define the one place they meet; with one you cannot define anything. Next, something related that will connect back to this.

sections.title: Above: the Essence that wills is the one that limits the will
sections.summary: The power of the vessels to limit the light comes from the *Atzmus*, the same place the light comes from. As a person who wants something is the one who decides how particular his want will be, G-d chooses the limitation as He chooses the desire, and only a limited will can have a reason and come into *chachma*.

blocks.title: I don't want no sardine sandwich
blocks.text: Hungry, you ask for something to eat, are offered a sardine sandwich, and do not want it. Shouldn't wanting food extend to anything? No: as you can say you want, you can say you don't. *Ratzon* is one power, to come out of yourself as much or as little as you choose.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: Once limited, it can come into *chachma*: knowing what you want and what not, you have a picture of it, a peanut butter and jelly sandwich, still a general limit, since you did not say which one.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: "This one's mine"
blocks.text: Or, being stubborn, you insist on that one of two identical ones. A little kid wants things to be his: when his mother lights the *Shabbos* candles, this one is his and that one his brother's, though they are exactly the same. You can decide that.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text:
Or keep it general: any candle, anything edible; or *davka* (specifically) this and nothing else. You can be as particular as you want.

The limitation comes from you, like the desire. Your body does not process a desire for food like a machine into wanting a certain thing; you need not even want food, you choose to. As you choose the desire, by *bechira* (choice), which is why it comes from your *etzem*, you choose its limitation.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: once you limit it then you can have a reason for the *ratzon*.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **Once you limit it then you can have a reason for the ratzon**: **if the light of the desire wouldn't stop, it could never come to a reason.** Wanting it for a certain thing already limits it to a general characteristic.

blocks.title: Chocolate, or the one in the right hand
blocks.text: Two flavors of ice cream: you want this one because it is chocolate. That is a reason, so it comes into *chachma*, a *sechel* (intellect) for what to get you. Or you always take what is on the right, and it is in the right hand: a reason with nothing to do with flavor.

blocks.text: Wanting it just because you want it never comes into *sechel*: the *ratzon* does not stop or connect to anything, so it stays *ratzon*, unlimited. Once you are *metzamtzem* it to wanting this, you have a picture of what you want: it becomes a matter and a reason for the will.

sections.title: The kav hamida makes every limit and is not limited: the vessels are no machine
sections.summary: The *kav hamida*, the measuring stick that can measure any size, makes every actual limit in the lights and in the vessels, yet is itself no limit: G-d chooses the light and also the vessel. Like a language or a law kept by convention, the vessels only seem to run by themselves; money is a vessel for *chesed* only because He chose it.

phrases.en: this is what makes every limitation in the lights, that it makes the light come out *davka* a certain way.

blocks.text: **This limitation is all from the maamar** (the saying) **of the kav hamida** (the line of measure): it measures how much your *ratzon* comes out, where it stops and how. It is a potential limitation: one measuring stick measures any size, so a system of measurement does not limit you. "The same power that lets you make the rules lets you break the rules," as chapter 15 said. **This is what makes every limitation in the lights**, **davka a certain way**.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: וכך הוא עושה כל גבול בפועל ממש בכלים
phrases.en: and it also makes every limitation in the vessels,

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: דעשר ספירות המגבילים, איך שיגבילו בפועל ממש
phrases.en: how they will limit it.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: אבל מקור ושרש שלהם אינו בחינת גבול אמיתי,
phrases.en: but the source, in other words the *Kav* itself, the power of the *Kav*, is not a real *gvul*,

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: רק שהוא עושה את אופן ההגבלה
phrases.en: it's just that it makes the limitation.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **And it also makes every limitation in the vessels**: the *kav hamida* gives you a *ratzon*, say to be kind, and chooses how you express it too. **But the source, in other words the Kav itself, the power of the Kav, is not a real gvul**: it defines the limit, unlimited itself, free to limit however it wants.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: Until now it may have sounded otherwise. The Arizal's (Rabbi Isaac Luria's) *hishtalshelus* (the chain of descent) speaks only of the light, so the vessels seem already set up: you choose the lights, the vessels automatically limit them, so once G-d chose *chesed* it automatically thickens into this world, or into the ten *sefiros* (the Divine attributes). Not at all: there is no point where it turns mechanistic, where G-d has to do it a certain way.

audio.lecture: 58 - Chap- 29-2 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: The rules of a language
blocks.text: Like a language: once the rules are set, a *ratzon* to say something, like a light, has to come out in certain words; to say apple, you say apple. But you also chose to set the language up that way, and can change it. Once chosen, the vessels seem a machine, light in and vessel out, "but it's really an illusion": you keep your poetic license, upholding the convention all the time.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Class 59 opens by continuing the explanation of line 25 from the end of class 58, before it reads line 26.

blocks.text: So with laws, as said long ago: they seem set and separate from you, with everything filtering through like a machine, but you choose all the time to uphold and interpret them by convention. They do not control you.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: Chesed means He gives me money
blocks.text:
So the vessels do not limit or control G-d, though once He chose a way it looks automatic: when G-d wants *chesed* He gives me money, when He wants *gevura* (restraint) He does not, since the light of *chesed* in its vessel turns into money. Then G-d chooses only the light, and the set vessel channels it into something physical.

But the vessels are not set either. Money is a *chesed* only because He made it its vessel, and He can make it a *gevura* vessel. G-d controls both halves, equally infinite, both from His choice.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: So nature is really higher than nature, and higher than nature is nature. The vessel, seemingly a set nature, is as infinite as the light, by G-d's choice; and the light, His choice to appear transcendent and infinite, is to Him as limited as the vessels.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: What money really is
blocks.text:
It depends how low a vessel: the vessel of *chesed* is the power to give life and create, and money is only its *levush* (garment), in *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* (the worlds of Creation, Formation and Action): the concept of money in *Yetzira*, currency in *Asiya*, since you need no bills and coins.

Wealth is not really a thing; people only know a person has money. Bill Gates owns a company and houses, not the money; your bank balance is yours only in theory. The *Asiya* thing is tangible, "cash, cold cash," and even that only represents something: the *kli* (vessel) alone. This is part of what he explains now.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

sections.title: The power to contract is equal to the power to spread: the reshimu and the Kav
sections.summary: The limit comes from the *gevura* of the *Ein Sof*, the power to contract, which is as infinite as the power to spread, because one who can do anything can also limit. The *reshimu* is G-d's ability to reveal something set and separate, the root of the vessels; the *Kav*, the root of the lights, is His conscious control of that separate thing.

phrases.en: which this limitation comes from the *kav hamida*,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: which is similar to the power to extend.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: They're two equal, opposite sides.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: כי כל יכול יש בו כח המגביל גם כן כו'
phrases.en: because if G-d can do anything, then that includes also the ability to make any limitation.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: as explained elsewhere.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **Which this limitation comes from the kav hamida, from the power of gevura of the Ein Sof** (the Infinite), to contract, equal to the power to extend, **two equal, opposite sides**, **because if G-d can do anything, then that includes also the ability to make any limitation**: as infinite or as limited as He wants.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: The throw and the light switch
blocks.text: Like your hand: able to throw as hard as you want, you can throw as soft as you want. A light switch you can turn on, you don't have to. So G-d's power to be infinite means He need not be; otherwise that would be an essential limitation.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: G-d is not essentially an infinite being; He has the power of infinity, so also of finitude. If He could not limit Himself, a bigger G-d would be telling Him what to do: "You go tell him that he can't do it."

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.question: Can G-d make a rock He cannot lift: can He make Himself limited and nothing else?
blocks.text: If G-d *mamash* made Himself only limited, all He is, was and will be, that is outside the *hishtalshelus*, beyond human intellect. In our *hishtalshelus* G-d is revealed through *Yachid*, *Echad* and *Kadmon* (single, one and original), the *Atzmus Ein Sof* seen only in all three together; that is the first *tzimtzum* (contraction). Without all three it makes no sense to us as G-d. We cannot speak of it, yet it is true: yes, He could, and lift it anyway. "Things do not have to make sense to us."

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: we explained before,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: that the power of limitation in the ten *sefiros* is coming from the *reshimu*,

phrases.en: and from the *Kav*,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: which comes from the *reshimu*,

phrases.en: that's the source of all the lights.

blocks.text: As **we explained before** (in chapter 15, he thinks, or later), **the power of limitation in the Ein Sof is the reshimu**, the root of the limits of the vessels: **the power of limitation in the ten sefiros is coming from the reshimu**, G-d's ability to reveal Himself as something separate, no longer tied to *bechira*, simply set.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **And from the Kav.** The light before the *tzimtzum* reveals only G-d, unlimited, doing whatever He wants; the *reshimu*, His ability to reveal something set, limited and apparently separate, no longer tied to choice. The *Kav* connects the two: G-d's infinite control over that separate, limited thing, however He wants.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: Like the soul entering the body, a separate, limited thing, controlling it and connecting with it. The *Kav*, **which comes from the reshimu**: **that's the source of all the lights**; they come from G-d choosing how to control the *kelim* (vessels).

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

sections.title: So He and His organs are one: even the vessels of Atzilus are only a limit in potential
sections.summary: The names *Ayin Beis* and *SaG*, the vessels of *Atzilus*, limit only because G-d chose it, so He is one with them as with the lights; they are a limit in potential, and only in *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* is there an actual limit. So the *hishtalshelus* is no machine, and one who has the names in mind in prayer has in mind the One who chooses to use them.

phrases.en: if so,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: גם שבחינת הכלים דאצילות מגבילים ממש
phrases.en: even though the vessels of *Atzilus* actually limit the light,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: which is the idea of the names of *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH*, *BaN*,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: which are called letters,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: הרי אין זה רק מצד כח העושה לגבול זה בעצמות המאציל
phrases.en: these limitations are coming from the power that makes it; in other words, that G-d chose that it should come out in this way.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: and this is why we say that He and His organs are one,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: because they're coming from the *koach* of the *Ein Sof* itself,

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: כמו דאיהו וחיוהי חד בבחינת האורות כו'
phrases.en: just like He is one with the lights.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **If so, even though the vessels of Atzilus actually limit the light, which is the idea of the names of Ayin Beis, SaG, MaH, BaN** (the Names of seventy-two, sixty-three, forty-five and fifty-two), **which are called letters**, G-d as a certain wisdom, like the Written Torah, still He chose it, from His very essence: it too reveals His *etzem*.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **And this is why we say that He and His organs are one**, **because they're coming from the koach** (the power) **of the Ein Sof itself**, G-d's *kol yachol* choosing them, **just like He is one with the lights**: as to the *etzem*, *mamash* no difference.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: Within our *hishtalshelus* the *tzimtzum* is not *kipshuto* (literal): G-d keeps His infinite ability and only makes it look limited; or, the other way, the limits always exist and the choice reveals some. Either is the *gilui* (revelation) of the *Atzmus*.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: The *Atzmus* cannot even be revealed, let alone pick up a rock; what is *Atzmus* good for anyway? *Ilu yedativ hayisiv* (if I knew Him, I would be Him). What comes out is the *Or Ein Sof*, the spreading light, not the *etzem d'Ein Sof*. *Chakira* (philosophical inquiry) says it cannot be revealed, nor can you be it; *Chassidus* (Chassidic teaching) says you can.

audio.lecture: 59 - Chap- 29-3 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: (ובאמת גם בחינת הכלים דעשר ספירות דאצילות הן כח הגבול,
phrases.en: really, even the vessels of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* are only a potential limitation,

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: not an actual limitation.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: רק כאשר האור ושפע נגבל מאין ליש בבי''ע, אז נקרא גבול בפועל ממש וכמו שיתבאר בעזרת השם)
phrases.en: only when the *kelim* of *Atzilus* actually do something in *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* is it considered a *gvul b'poel*.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **Really, even the vessels of the ten sefiros of Atzilus are only a potential limitation, not an actual limitation.** **Only when the kelim of Atzilus actually do something in Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya is it considered a gvul b'poel.** Your hand has a range of motion, but while still it does not limit you: a *gvul b'koach* (a limit in potential), just *etzem* and *mahus*. Moving, it is *metzius* (existence), coming out a certain, circumstantial way.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text:
So far: chapters 27 and 28 gave the general idea of lights and vessels. Then, when you are *misbonen* (contemplating) on them, the main point is *ihu v'chayohi chad*, *ihu v'garmohi chad*: *Hashem* is one with light and vessel equally, both directly His choice.

For that we explained *gvul b'koach* and *gvul b'poel*: your arm moves only certain ways but forces no one movement, so within that context it is still called infinite; an actual limit is the actual throw. All comes from the *kav hamida*, His choice. Then the *kavanos* (intentions): you can be *mechaven* (have in mind) the light or the vessel.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: Lights come from the *Kav*, vessels from the *reshimu*, both from G-d's choice. The vessels of *Atzilus*, the names *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH* and *BaN*, called letters, are only a *gvul b'koach*, so the actual limit through them is chosen by G-d. His creative power, the light of *chesed*, goes through the vessel of *chesed* into *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, not like a machine, light in and world out: how it comes out is His choice too. So He is one with the vessels.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: "This is the big statement," against common belief, though nobody believes otherwise passionately: most people picture the *hishtalshelus* as a machine. Though there are vessels, limited, *chachma* and *bina* (understanding), they are not machines; G-d chooses how and when to use them.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: that the source of the names *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH*, *BaN* is the source of the light of *Atzilus* actually.

blocks.text: **And based on this, when somebody's mechaven different names**, davening *Shemoneh Esrei* with the Arizal's *kavanos*, this blessing in *chesed*, that one in *gevura*, the vessels that limit, and thinks how G-d's *chesed* came out, **really you're being mechaven to the source, the one that chose to use it and do it in that way.**

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: Seeing that G-d does it, you can look at how kind He is, or at what He did, giving you money, the vessel. Once you see that He did not have to and chose to, you think not of the vessel but of Him, the one behind it.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: With a person that is obvious, but people ask if you are *mechaven* to the *sefira* of *chesed*. So do not use the Arizal's *kavanos* without understanding them, or you will think it a machine, davening to *chesed* and *gevura*; understood, they help you be *mechaven* to *Hashem*.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: On the level of *pshat* (the plain meaning) too: G-d brings the rain, blows the wind and grows the grass, but He is not a force that blows the wind; higher than it and undefined by it, He chose to do it. The *kavana* of the names is to see past them to Him choosing.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **The source of the names Ayin Beis, SaG, MaH, BaN is the source of the light of Atzilus actually**: so seeing past the vessels to the source, the *kavana* in them is the same as in the light. Some places say to be *mechaven* to the light in the vessel, not the vessel; all mean that you should be talking to G-d.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: Why names and *kavanos*, if you only want to talk to G-d? To recognize what He does for you: calling Him King, see how He rules everything, how kind He is, what good He does you.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: (uוהוא שם העצם, שהוא מורה על עצם המקור כנזכר לעיל)
phrases.en: the real thing of *Shem Havaya* is really the *shem ha'etzem*, that's G-d's name.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: A name and a title
blocks.text: The real *Shem Havaya* (the four-letter Name) is the *shem ha'etzem* (the proper name), G-d's name. Some names are titles: father, doctor, teacher. A person's own name, like Shmuel, means something too (G-d listened to Chana's prayer for a child), but that is not the main thing: it is just who he is. So *Havaya* connotes *haya hoveh v'yihyeh* (He was, is and will be) and *mehaveh*, constantly creating, but it is simply G-d's name, like "G-d" in English.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: that's the source that creates the vessels,

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: because here this is the idea that Him and His organs are one, that G-d is one with the vessels.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **That's the source that creates the vessels**, **because here this is the idea that Him and His organs are one**: He made their rules and limits and uses them as He wants. A person only controls a body he did not create; G-d controls the vessels because He decided their limits to begin with.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

sections.title: The tikunim, and the vessels of brain and heart, have their root in the Essence like the lights
sections.summary: Even the *tikunim*, the vessels used as garments to do things, are one with Him, because an actual limit is united with the potential power that makes it, as a deed reflects the one who chose it. All the more the vessels of brain and heart, which only give the lights a recognizable form; their root is in the *Atzmus* with the lights, one power that can be as limited or unlimited as He wants.

phrases.en: and automatically it's understood,

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: that even the level of the vessels which are called *tikunim*,

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: על זה אמר גם כן איהו וגרמוהי חד
phrases.en: even on that we say that He is one with His organs,

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **And automatically it's understood, that even the level of the vessels which are called tikunim**: vessels are *kelim*, and they are *tikunim*, garments. As vessels, the light rests in them, like consciousness in the brain or emotions in the heart. As *tikunim* they make an actual limit, not just a *gvul b'koach*: you actually walk, talk, think certain thoughts.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: So when G-d not only calls Himself Creator but creates, putting on the mask of a Creator, with creation the garment that reveals Him: **even on that we say that He is one with His organs.**

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.en: that makes the limitation in the actual limitation.

phrases.he: על דרך דוגמא מכח המגביל שביד,
phrases.en: like power of movement in your hand,

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

phrases.he: שמיוחד ומקושר בגבול בפועל שבתנועה כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: which connects to the actual movement that you make.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.title: The painting and the gift
blocks.text: **Because the actual limitation connects with the potential limitation, that makes the limitation in the actual limitation.** Your painting reflects your artistic ability; giving money shows how nice you are, since you chose to. What comes out is separate from you, yet reveals you, following your ability and your choice.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: **Like power of movement in your hand, which connects to the actual movement that you make**: punch somebody, and you chose to use your hand's ability, so you are responsible.

audio.lecture: 60 - Chap- 29-4 Gvul biKoach and Gvul biPoel.mp3

blocks.text: Someone not in control of his body is not responsible. A person who has a seizure, G-d forbid, he thinks would not be, except maybe if he knew he gets them and did nothing about it. A sleeper who breaks something he knew was next to his bed is responsible; if it was put there after he fell asleep, he is not. A man totally drunk is not responsible, because he did not know what he was doing. But if you know what you are doing, the deed is connected to you, so you are responsible: it reflects on you.

sections.title: In their root it is reversed: as revealed the light is limited and the vessels spread
sections.summary: As they are revealed, the *tzimtzum* is in the lights and the spreading is in the vessels, as a teacher's many words reveal more by limiting the idea. In their root it is the opposite: the *tzimtzum* is in the *reshimu* and the spreading in the lights of the *Kav*, as what is *chesed* to the giver is *gevura* to the receiver; and our main revelation of G-d is through His limiting Himself.

blocks.title: The teacher's many words
blocks.text: The more words a teacher says (not wasted ones), the more he explains and the better they understand. So the *chesed*, the revelation, comes through many letters, many vessels, and the light is greatly limited into examples and details: *tzimtzum* in the light, **and the chasadim** (the kindnesses) **is happening in the vessels.**

blocks.text: To the teacher, the light, the idea, is infinite, and the vessels, the language he must fit it into, a great limit. But once it fits, the more words he says, the more the recipient gets.

blocks.title: The Rebbe in his room
blocks.text: Take the Rebbe. His *sichos* and *maamarim* we call *gilui*, *chesed*; his staying in his room, *gevura*, *helem* (concealment). For him it is the opposite: in his room he is himself, a far bigger *chesed*. Coming out, he must be *metzamtzem* himself, explaining things in a very stupid way to us, slowly, with little jokes, over and over because they don't get it. There is a *chiddush* (new insight) each time, but next to him it is "so ridiculous, such a limitation."

sensitivity.reason: Says the Rebbe, coming out, has to explain things "in a very stupid way to us" with "little jokes", and calls his talks next to his level "so ridiculous": meant as the measure of the Rebbe's tzimtzum, but blunt about the Rebbe's public talks.
sensitivity.publishable: Take the Rebbe. His *sichos* and *maamarim* we call *gilui*, *chesed*; his staying in his room, *gevura*, *helem* (concealment). For him it is the opposite: in his room he is himself, a far bigger *chesed*. Coming out, he must be *metzamtzem* himself, explaining things on our level, slowly, over and over until we get it. There is a *chiddush* (new insight) each time, but next to him it is a great limitation.

blocks.text: So it switches: our main *gilui* of G-d comes from the *tzimtzum*, His choosing the vessels to limit Himself in a way we can appreciate. The source shows only the power of limit, in a way the more limited thing.

reviewQuestions.question: Why does the root of the vessels come before the root of the lights, and what do the cup and the seed show about it?
What are the two differences between a gvul b'koach and a gvul b'poel, as shown with the hand, the cartwheel and the thrown ball?
How does the sardine sandwich show that the same source that wills also limits the will, and why can only a limited will have a reason?
Why is it wrong to think that once G-d chooses chesed, the vessel automatically turns it into money?
What are the light before the tzimtzum, the reshimu and the Kav, and which is the root of the vessels?
How is the order of tzimtzum and spreading reversed between the revelation of the lights and vessels and their root, and how does the teacher show it?
